theorem_cards.label: Theorem1 smooth comparison; soft maximum
assumptions: Centered Gaussian X,Y in R^p, arbitrary PSD covariance; same means zero.
theorem_cards.statement: Fβ=β^-1 logΣexp(βzj), 0≤Fβ−max≤log(p)/β. |Eg(FβX)−Eg(FβY)|≤Δ(||g″||∞/2+β||g′||∞); max version adds2||g′||∞log(p)/β. Optimized extra2||g′||∞sqrt(2Δlogp).
proof_steps: log-sum-exp deterministic bracket; derivatives πj and β(diagπ−ππᵀ).
Σπj=1,Σjk|wjk|=2(1−Σπj²)≤2. Gaussian interpolation/Stein gives Δ/2 times Hessian entrywise l1.
gaps: Indicator g is not C²: cannot directly apply to Kolmogorov distance.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem2 Kolmogorov comparison
assumptions: p≥2; Y marginal variances strictly positive; X may be singular/zero variance.
C depends on min/max Y marginal variance, not universal under variance collapse.
proof_steps: Smooth indicator widthδ plus Fβ bracket yields C(δ^-2+βδ^-1)Δ plus Lévy concentration at logp/β+δ.
Choose β=δ^-1 logp, δ=Δ^(1/3)(1∨a)^(-1/3)(2logp)^(1/3), a=a_p∨sqrt(log1/Δ), 0<Δ<1; remaining Δ≥1 use trivial bound.
gaps: Original pp3–4 prints a_p=Emax(Yj/σY_jj) with σY_jj covariance diagonal, not square root; p5 then claims a_p≤sqrt(2logp) as if standard-normalized. PDF confirms literal notation inconsistency. Use explicitly defined b_p=Emax(Yj/sqrt(σY_jj)) in transferable version and absorb fixed variance bounds into C; do not silently quote printed a_p as standardization.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem3 Gaussian maximum anti-concentration
assumptions: Centered finite Gaussian vector; σj²=EXj²>0, σmin>0, σmax finite; singular covariance permitted.
a_p=Emax_j(Xj/σj), standard-deviation normalization here explicitly stated; ε>0.
theorem_cards.statement: L(maxX,ε)=sup_xP(|maxX−x|≤ε). Equal variances:≤4ε(a_p+1)/σ. Unequal:≤Cε{a_p+sqrt(1∨log(σmin/ε))}, C depends onlyσmin,σmax. Corollary≤Cεsqrt(1∨log(p/ε)); equal replaces inner log(p/ε) bylogp.
proof_steps: Standardnormal Gaussian maximum expectation≤sqrt(2logp).
For max|Xj| use2p vector(X,−X), whose marginalvariances remainpositive despite degeneracy.
gaps: Comment5 p9 literal formula4(a′p+1)/σ is missingε. Checked corrected version4ε(a′p+1)/σ follows directlyTheorem3 via doubling.
Not uniform over σmin→0; X=0 has Lévy concentration1.
Dimension-free means only through a_p; iid standardnormal a_p~sqrt(2logp), not universally bounded.
Lévy interval anti-concentration differs from origin smallball P(max|X|≤x).

theorem_cards.label: Example2 iid sharpness and Gumbel scaling
assumptions: iid standardGaussian; p→∞; fixedK orK′; ε≤K′/a_p.
theorem_cards.statement: b_p=sqrt(2logp),d_p=b_p−(loglogp+log4π)/(2b_p); density of b_p(maxX−d_p)→e^-x exp(−e^-x) locally uniformly. L(maxX,ε)≥c′εa_p for sufficientlylargep and0≤ε≤K′/a_p.
proof_steps: Explicit iid maxdensity pφΦ^(p−1), expand log of pφ(dp+x/bp)/bp.
Uniform positivity oncompact scaling window ⇒density≥c bp ⇒interval probability≥2c εbp.
gaps: Gumbel weaklimit and Emax lowerbound invoke external[14],[11]; not independently rederived inthis card.
